# Pearl Sailing Cruises Paros

> Sailing cruises around Paros, Antiparos and Despotiko (Cyclades, Greece) aboard Pearl, a 45-foot Beneteau sailing yacht. Based at the harbour of Aliki, Paros.

- Address: Aliki Harbour, Aliki, Paros 844 00, Greece
- Telephone: (+30) 694 965 9118
- Email: info@pearl-paros.gr
- Online booking: https://www.planyo.com/booking.php?calendar=70733
- Google listing: https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id:ChIJhXWGG3NvmBQR0YkQ9l62-SU
- Google rating: 5.0 out of 5 from 119 reviews (checked 2026-11-16)
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/pearl_paros_sailing_cruises/
- Languages: English, Greek

## The boat

Pearl is an exceptionally comfortable Beneteau sailing boat with a modern interior and luxurious deck features. The 45-foot length of Pearl allows for a good balance of stability and maneuverability, making it suitable for both engine cruising and sailing!

## Cruises

### Semi-private

Discover the breathtaking beauty of Antiparos on a memorable 7-hour cruise, combining crystal-clear waters, spectacular coastal landscapes, and authentic Greek flavours in a relaxed, small-group setting. Departing at 10:00 and returning at 17:00, this full-day adventure takes you to five spectacular swimming stops: the Blue Lagoon at Panteronisia, Agios Nikolaos, the Epitafios Cave, Despotiko Island and, where conditions and safety permit, a thrilling cliff-diving spot on Antiparos. A delicious Mediterranean lunch is served on board: freshly cooked shrimp pasta, traditional Greek salad, authentic Greek taramosalata and marinated Greek anchovies, with a generous appetizer platter, a fresh seasonal fruit platter, local white wine, beer, soft drinks and bottled water. Snorkelling equipment is complimentary. €150 per person plus a 5% booking fee (€157.50 in total). Maximum 12 guests, adults only. A 50% deposit confirms your reservation; the remaining balance is paid on board. The itinerary may be adjusted according to weather and sea conditions.

- How to book: online at https://www.planyo.com/booking.php?calendar=70733

### Private tour

Set sail on your own special adventure with a private sailing cruise made just for you. Aboard our beautiful sailboat, you'll experience personalised service and exclusivity as you navigate the open waters. Whether it's a romantic getaway, a family adventure, or a celebration with friends, the friendly crew will take care of everything, making your tour a unique and unforgettable experience!

- How to book: by email to info@pearl-paros.gr

### Sunset

Embark on an unforgettable 3-hour private sunset cruise to the Blue Lagoon from Aliki. Departing at 18:00 and returning at 21:00, your journey takes you to the spectacular Blue Lagoon (Panteronisia) and Agios Nikolaos. Swim and snorkel in the crystal-clear waters using the equipment provided, or relax on board with your favourite music while enjoying the golden hour magic. A fresh seasonal fruit platter, local white wine, beer, soft drinks and bottled water are included. With the fruit platter and drinks: €500 for up to 8 guests, €30 for each additional guest. With a Mediterranean dinner on board (freshly cooked shrimp pasta, traditional Greek salad, taramosalata and marinated anchovies) and drinks: €600 for up to 8 guests, €40 for each additional guest. A 5% booking fee is added. Online booking is for up to 12 guests. A 50% deposit confirms your reservation; the remaining balance is payable anytime or on board. The itinerary may be adjusted according to weather and sea conditions.

- How to book: online at https://www.planyo.com/booking.php?calendar=70733

### Special occasions

Our committed team is ready to help you plan and execute a well-organized event to meet the highest standards of excellence. Whether it's a birthday, anniversary, or intimate gathering, the gentle sway of the boat and the vast expanse of the sea create a unique and enchanting setting.

- How to book: by email to info@pearl-paros.gr

## Cancellation

- 72 hours or more before departure: full refund available.
- Between 72 and 48 hours before departure: 50% refund available.
- Less than 48 hours: no refund available.
- Operator cancellation: In the event that we need to cancel the cruise due to weather conditions or other unforeseen circumstances, customers will be offered either a full refund or the option of rescheduling.
- No-shows: Failure to arrive for the scheduled cruise will result in the full booking amount being charged, with no refund.

## Terms and conditions

1. Booking and Reservations: All bookings are subject to availability and confirmation. The reservation is confirmed once payment has been completed.
2. Weather Conditions: The cruise is subject to suitable weather and sea conditions. For safety reasons, the captain reserves the right to change the route, postpone or cancel the cruise if weather or sea conditions are unsuitable.
3. Safety on Board: All passengers must follow the captain’s safety instructions throughout the cruise. The captain has full authority regarding navigation and safety decisions.
4. Passenger Responsibilities: Passengers must behave responsibly and respect the boat, crew and other guests. Any damage caused intentionally or through negligence may result in liability for the responsible passenger, subject to applicable law.
5. Arrival Time: Passengers are requested to arrive at the agreed meeting point at least 15 minutes before departure.
6. Health and Safety: Passengers should inform the company in advance of any medical conditions, mobility limitations or special requirements that may affect their participation.
7. Children: Children must be supervised by their parents or responsible adults throughout the cruise.
8. Route and Itinerary: The cruise itinerary may be adjusted depending on weather, sea conditions and safety considerations.
9. Respect for the Environment: Passengers are requested to respect the marine environment and avoid throwing rubbish into the sea.
10. Insurance: The cruise is operated subject to applicable Greek maritime safety and insurance requirements.
11. Applicable Law: These terms and conditions are subject to applicable Greek and European Union laws.
